reason: Free listing sounds fine and I'd let them load my flyers, but I wouldn't pay anything until I see the app actually has people using it in my city. A monthly fee is a cost I have to justify on a bar budget.
objection: I've been burned by boosts that give no real numbers. Show me the audience and the stats first; until then 39 euro a month is a guess.
would_change_my_mind: Published monthly users above 2,000 in my city, plus proof from another bar that the stats on views and saves match people actually showing up on music nights.
